## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to relate an agent to a [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) it makes — the entry point into the offerings surface.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a raw item (the item is the [`gmeow:itemOffered`](gmeow-itemOffered.md) inside the [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md)) and avoid carrying provider on it — the provider is [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](gmeow-offeringProvider.md) on the [`Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md).

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:makesOffer`](gmeow-makesOffer.md) triple per [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) the agent makes; the [`Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) then names its [`gmeow:itemOffered`](gmeow-itemOffered.md) and [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](gmeow-offeringProvider.md).

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:makesOffer`](gmeow-makesOffer.md) ex:hostingOffer.
